```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(multidplyr)
library(patchwork)
library(edisetr)

# fixed colour mapping for repeat classes, reused across all plots
rep_type_cols <- setNames(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(3, 'Dark2'), c('ALU', 'REP', 'NONREP'))

# shared interactive datatable helper (copy/csv/excel buttons, signif formatting)
esf_datatable <- function(x, digits = 3) {
  DT::datatable(
    x,
    rownames = FALSE,
    colnames = str_replace_all(names(x), '_', ' '),
    extensions = 'Buttons',
    options = list(
      dom = 'Bfrtip', buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel'),
      scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 10
    )
  ) %>%
    DT::formatSignif(columns = which(map_lgl(x, is.numeric)), digits = digits)
}

# check params
stopifnot(
  is.character(params$edisites),
  length(Sys.glob(params$edisites)) > 0,
  file.exists(params$metadata),
  is_scalar_integer(params$min_med_dp),
  is_scalar_double(params$min_med_vaf) || is_scalar_integer(params$min_med_vaf),
  is_scalar_double(params$max_med_vaf) || is_scalar_integer(params$max_med_vaf),
  is_scalar_integer(params$grp_min_med_dp),
  is_scalar_double(params$grp_min_med_vaf) || is_scalar_integer(params$grp_min_med_vaf),
  is_scalar_double(params$grp_max_med_vaf) || is_scalar_integer(params$grp_max_med_vaf),
  is_scalar_double(params$sig_q) || is_scalar_integer(params$sig_q),
  params$sig_q > 0, params$sig_q <= 1,
  is.null(params$fixed_effects) || is_character(params$fixed_effects)
)

# check sample medatadata
sample_metadata <- read_csv(params$metadata) 
fixed_effects <- NULL
if (!is.null(params$fixed_effects)) {
  fixed_effects <- c(str_split(params$fixed_effects,pattern = ',', simplify = T))
}
stopifnot(
  nrow(sample_metadata) > 2,
  "sample_id" %in% colnames(sample_metadata),
  "group"     %in% colnames(sample_metadata),
  is.null(fixed_effects) || all(fixed_effects%in% colnames(sample_metadata))
)
# ensure group is a character for GLM fitting
sample_metadata <- mutate(sample_metadata, group = as.character(group))
```

```{r read_edisites}
threads <- min(params$threads, length(Sys.glob(params$edisites)))
if (threads > 1) {
  if (!exists('cluster') || !edisetr::cluster_check(cluster, stop=FALSE)) {
    cluster <- multidplyr::new_cluster(threads)
  }
} else {
  cluster <- NULL
}

edisites <- 
  edisetr::read_edisites(
    sites_files     = params$edisites,
    cluster         = cluster,
    min_med_dp      = params$min_med_dp,
    min_med_vaf     = params$min_med_vaf,
    max_med_vaf     = params$max_med_vaf,
    adar_only       = params$adar_only,
    snp_detect      = TRUE,
    sample_group    = select(sample_metadata, sample_id, group),
    grp_min_med_dp  = params$grp_min_med_dp,
    grp_min_med_vaf = params$grp_min_med_vaf,
    grp_max_med_vaf = params$grp_max_med_vaf,
    drop_failed     =  TRUE,
    .n_max          = Inf
  )

```

```{r run_summary}
#| results: asis
cat(sprintf(
"::: {.callout-note}\n## Run summary\n- **Samples:** %s\n- **Groups:** %s\n- **Candidate sites:** %s\n- **Passing filters:** %s (%.1f%%)\n- **ADAR (A>I) sites:** %s\n:::\n",
  format(nrow(edisites$sample_summary), big.mark = ','),
  format(n_distinct(sample_metadata$group), big.mark = ','),
  format(nrow(edisites$summary), big.mark = ','),
  format(sum(edisites$summary$pass), big.mark = ','),
  100 * mean(edisites$summary$pass),
  format(sum(edisites$summary$pass & edisites$summary$is_adar), big.mark = ',')
))
```

## QC

Quality-control views of the candidate editing sites and the samples they were called in, before any differential analysis.

### Filtering

How many candidate sites passed the site-level filters, broken down by the reason(s) failing sites were excluded.

```{r filtering_summary}
edisites$summary %>% 
  count(reason) %>% 
  mutate(
    prop = n / sum(n),
    reason = replace_na(reason, 'pass'),
    reasons = reason) %>% 
  separate_rows(reason, sep =';') %>% 
  group_by(reason) %>%
  mutate(nr = sum(n),) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  arrange(nr) %>% 
  mutate(
    reason = factor(reason, unique(c('pass', reason))),
    reasons = if_else(prop < 0.01, 'other', reasons),
    status = if_else(reason == 'pass', 'Included', 'Excluded')) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(reason, prop)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = reasons)) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title  = 'Site Filtering Summary',
    subtitle = str_c(
      format(sum(edisites$summary$pass),  big.mark = ','), 
      ' of ',
      format(nrow(edisites$summary),  big.mark = ','),
      ' sites passed (',
      format(100 * sum(edisites$summary$pass) / nrow(edisites$summary),  digits =  3),
      '%)'
    ),
    y = 'Proportion of sites',
    x = 'Filtering Reason',
    fill = 'Reason intersect'
  ) +
  facet_grid(status ~ ., scales = 'free_y', space = 'free_y',switch = 'y')
```

### Coverage & rate

Median read depth versus median editing rate (VAF), per site (left) and per sample (right), to spot coverage or rate outliers.

```{r depth_vaf}
p1 <-
  edisites$summary %>% 
  filter(pass) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(med_depth, med_vaf)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.05, size = 0.1) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    trans = 'log1p',
    ) +
  labs(
    title = 'Site-wise depth vs VAF',
    y = 'Median Editing VAF',
    x = 'Median Depth'
  )

p2 <-
  edisites$sample_summary %>% 
  ggplot(aes(med_depth, med_vaf)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.25, size = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = 'Sample-wise depth vs VAF',
    y = 'Median Editing VAF',
    x = 'Median Depth'
  )

(p1 + p2)
```

### Sample summary table

Per-sample depth, editing rate and editing indices.
```{r sample_smry}
edisites$sample_summary %>%
  esf_datatable()
```

## Editing Summary

Genome-wide characterisation of the detected editing sites: which base changes occur, how strongly they are edited, and where they sit relative to repeats and gene features.

### Base change distribution

Frequency of each base change, its editing rate, and its split by repeat class (ALU / REP / NONREP). A>G on the sense strand indicates ADAR (A-to-I) editing.

```{r sites_basechange_smry}

basechange_smry <-
  edisites$summary %>%
  filter(pass | reason == 'non_adar') %>% 
  mutate(base_change = get_base_change(site_id)) %>% 
  select(base_change, rep_type, med_vaf) %>%  
  mutate(rep_type = factor(rep_type, c('ALU', 'REP', 'NONREP'))) %>% 
  add_count(base_change) %>% 
  arrange(n) %>% 
  mutate(base_change = as_factor(base_change))

p1 <- 
  basechange_smry %>% 
  select(base_change, n) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  ggplot(aes(base_change, n)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = base_change), show.legend = F) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(family = "Courier")) +
  labs(x = 'Base change', y = 'Count')

p2 <-
  basechange_smry %>% 
  ggplot(aes(base_change, med_vaf)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(fill = base_change),
    show.legend = FALSE,
    outlier.alpha = 0.25,
    outlier.size = 1
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.title.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank())  +
  labs(y = 'Median Rate')

p3 <-
  basechange_smry %>% 
  count(base_change, rep_type) %>% 
  group_by(base_change) %>% 
  mutate(prop = n /sum(n)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(base_change, prop)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = rep_type)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = rep_type_cols) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme(
    legend.position = 'right',
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
    y = 'Proportion',
    fill = 'Repeat type'
  )


(p1 | p2 | p3) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = 'Base change frequency, editing rate and repeat type'
  )
```

### Editing site consequences

Predicted functional consequence (VEP) of ADAR sites, with editing rate and repeat-class breakdown. Sites with multiple consequences are weighted equally across them.

```{r vep_csq_smry}
vep_csq_smry <-
  edisites$summary %>% 
  filter(pass, is_adar) %>% 
  select(site_id, med_vaf, rep_type, consequence) %>% 
  mutate(rep_type = factor(rep_type, c('ALU', 'REP', 'NONREP'))) %>% 
  separate_rows(consequence, sep = '&') %>% 
  group_by(site_id) %>% 
  mutate(weight = 1 /n()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(!is.na(consequence)) %>%  
  group_by(consequence) %>% 
  mutate(weighted_total = sum(weight)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  arrange(weighted_total) %>% 
  filter(weighted_total / sum(unique(weighted_total)) > 0.0001) %>%
  mutate(consequence = 
           str_replace_all(consequence, '_', ' ') %>% 
           str_remove(' variant$') %>% 
           str_wrap(width = 20)) %>% 
  mutate(consequence = as_factor(consequence))

p1 <- 
  vep_csq_smry %>% 
  select(consequence, weighted_total) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  ggplot(aes(consequence, weighted_total)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = consequence), show.legend = F) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5)) +
  labs(
    x = 'Variant Consequence', 
    y = 'Total'
  )


p2 <-
  vep_csq_smry %>% 
  ggplot(aes(consequence, med_vaf)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(fill = consequence),
    show.legend = FALSE,
    outlier.alpha = 0.25,
    outlier.size = 1
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  )  +
  labs(y = 'Median Rate')

p3 <-
  vep_csq_smry %>% 
  select(rep_type, consequence, weight) %>% 
  group_by(consequence, rep_type) %>% 
  summarise(weight = sum(weight), .groups = 'drop') %>% 
  group_by(consequence) %>% 
  mutate(prop = weight /sum(weight)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(consequence, prop)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = rep_type)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = rep_type_cols) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme(
    legend.position = 'right',
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
    y = 'Proportion',
    fill = 'Repeat type'
  )


(p1 | p2 |p3) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = 'ADAR editing by variant consequence and repeat type'
  )

```

### Highly edited sites by VEP impact

The most highly edited sites (top 100 by median VAF) within each VEP impact category, for inspection of functionally notable edits.

```{r top_edited_sites}
top_edited <-
  edisites$summary %>%
  filter(pass) %>%
  select(symbol, site_id, med_vaf, rep_type, impact, consequence, amino_acids, redi_acc) %>%
  mutate(impact = factor(impact, c('HIGH', 'MODERATE', 'LOW', 'MODIFIER'))) %>%
  group_by(impact) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = med_vaf, n = 100, with_ties = F) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(impact, desc(med_vaf))
```

:::

```{r fit_edisites}
covariates_df <-
    sample_metadata %>%
    select(sample_id, group, all_of(fixed_effects))

edifit <- fit_edisites(
  counts_df     = edisites$counts,
  covariates_df = covariates_df,
  fixed_effects = fixed_effects,
  model         = params$model,
  fdr_bh        = TRUE,
  permute_group = FALSE
)
```

## Differential editing by group

Tests for whether each site's editing rate differs across the sample groups (ANOVA on the group term of the per-site GLM), followed by the sites and genes driving those differences.

```{r anova_prep}
# shared significance threshold (BH q-value) used across this section
sig_q <- params$sig_q

manh_dat <-
  edifit$anova %>%
  left_join(
    edisites$summary %>% 
      select(site_id, is_adar, rep_type, consequence, impact, symbol, biotype, amino_acids),
    by = 'site_id'
  ) %>% 
  filter(term == 'group') %>% 
  mutate(
    chrom = get_chrom(site_id),
    pos = get_pos(site_id)
  ) %>% 
  arrange(
    str_extract(chrom, '[0-9]+') %>% as.integer(),
    pos
  ) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(pos)) %>% 
  group_by(chrom) %>% 
  mutate(max_pos = max(pos, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  nest(data = -c(chrom, max_pos)) %>% 
  mutate(
    offset = lag(max_pos, default = 0) %>% as.numeric() %>% cumsum(),
    mid    = offset + (max_pos / 2),
    colg   = as_factor(rep(c(1:2), length.out=n()))) %>%
  unnest(data) %>%
  mutate(pos = pos+offset) %>%
  filter(!chrom %in% c('chrY', 'chrM')) %>%
  mutate(
    logp = -log10(q_value_bh),
    is_missense = str_detect(consequence, 'missense') %>% replace_na(FALSE)
  )

manh_labels <-
  manh_dat %>%
  group_by(chrom) %>%
  summarise(
    start = min(pos), end = max(pos), mid = first(mid),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  mutate(chrom = str_remove(chrom, 'chr'))

# top-labelled genes per repeat type (best site per gene symbol)
man_genes <-
  manh_dat %>%
  group_by(rep_type, symbol) %>%
  slice_min(p_value, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  group_by(rep_type) %>%
  slice_min(p_value, n = 6, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(symbol = if_else(
    !is.na(amino_acids),
    str_c(symbol, ' (', str_replace(amino_acids, '/', '>'), ')'),
    symbol)
  ) %>%
  mutate(symbol = replace_na(symbol, 'Intergenic')) %>%
  select(site_id, pos, symbol, rep_type, p_value, q_value_bh, logp)
```

```{r diff_summary}
#| results: asis
cat(sprintf(
"::: {.callout-note}\n## Differential editing\n- **Sites tested:** %s\n- **Differentially edited** (q < %s): %s (%.1f%%)\n:::\n",
  format(nrow(manh_dat), big.mark = ','),
  format(sig_q, scientific = FALSE),
  format(sum(manh_dat$q_value_bh < sig_q, na.rm = TRUE), big.mark = ','),
  100 * mean(manh_dat$q_value_bh < sig_q, na.rm = TRUE)
))
```

### Number of differentially edited sites

Counts (left) and proportions (right) of sites with a significant group effect, split by repeat class.

```{r anova_rate}
p1 <-
  manh_dat %>%
  mutate(is_sig = q_value_bh < sig_q) %>%
  count(is_sig, rep_type) %>%
  group_by(rep_type) %>%
  mutate(p = n / sum(n)) %>%
  mutate(rep_type = factor(rep_type, c('ALU', 'REP', 'NONREP'))) %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_col(aes(rep_type, n, fill = is_sig)) +
  theme(legend.position = 'top') +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    fill = str_c('Significant group effect\nq-value BH < ', sig_q),
    x = 'Repeat type', y = 'Count'
  )

p2 <-
  manh_dat %>%
  mutate(is_sig = q_value_bh < sig_q) %>%
  count(is_sig, rep_type) %>%
  group_by(rep_type) %>%
  mutate(p = n / sum(n)) %>%
  mutate(rep_type = factor(rep_type, c('ALU', 'REP', 'NONREP'))) %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_col(aes(rep_type, p, fill = is_sig), show.legend = F) +
  coord_flip()+
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
    fill = str_c('Significant group effect\nq-value BH < ', sig_q),
    y = 'Proportion'
  )

p1 + p2

```

### Differential editing Manhattan-style plot

Each point is a site; height is the BH-corrected significance of the group effect. Panels split sites by repeat class (ALU / REP / NONREP), missense sites are highlighted in gold, and the strongest 6 genes per class are labelled.

```{r anova_manhattan}
manh_dat %>%
  ggplot(aes(pos, logp)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(col = colg),
    size = 0.3,
    show.legend = F
  ) +
  geom_point(
    col = 'gold',
    size = 0.3,
    show.legend = F,
    data = manh_dat %>% filter(is_missense)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(`1` = "gray30", `2` = "gray55")
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    aes(label = symbol),
    min.segment.length = 0,
    data = man_genes,
    fill  = alpha("white", 0.7),
    size = 3.5,
    label.padding = 0.15
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = manh_labels$mid,
    minor_breaks = c(manh_labels$start, last(manh_labels$end)),
    labels = manh_labels$chrom
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~rep_type, ncol = 1, strip.position = 'right', scales = 'free_y') +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = 'Anova test for group effect',
    subtitle = 'Missense sites highlighted in gold',
    x = 'Chromosome',
    y = '-log10 q-value'
  )
```

```{r marg_rate}
marg_rate <-
  edifit$anova %>% 
  filter(term == 'group') %>% 
  slice_min(order_by = p_value, n = 10000, with_ties = F) %>% 
  select(site_id) %>% 
  left_join(
    edifit$margins,
    by = 'site_id'
  ) %>% 
  select(site_id, group, estimate) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = estimate) %>% 
  na.omit() %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  column_to_rownames('site_id') %>% 
  t()

if (n_distinct(sample_metadata$group) > 2) {
  group_clust <- hclust(dist(marg_rate), method = 'average')
  group_ord <- rev(group_clust$labels[group_clust$order])
} else {
  group_ord <- unique(sample_metadata$group)
}

```

### Marginal editing by group at top differential sites

Model-estimated editing rate per group (error bars) with the underlying per-sample VAFs (points) at the top-labelled sites, split into tabs by repeat class plus a tab for the top missense sites.

```{r top_6_diff}

# top missense sites (best per gene, regardless of repeat class) for a dedicated tab
missense_genes <-
  manh_dat %>%
  filter(is_missense) %>%
  group_by(symbol) %>%
  slice_min(p_value, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  slice_min(p_value, n = 6, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(symbol = if_else(
    !is.na(amino_acids),
    str_c(symbol, ' (', str_replace(amino_acids, '/', '>'), ')'),
    symbol)
  ) %>%
  mutate(symbol = replace_na(symbol, 'Intergenic')) %>%
  select(site_id, pos, symbol, rep_type, p_value, q_value_bh, logp)

# `category` drives the tabs: repeat class for most, plus a MISSENSE group
top_diffed_marg <-
  bind_rows(
    man_genes %>% mutate(category = rep_type),
    missense_genes %>% mutate(category = 'MISSENSE')
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_value) %>%
  left_join(edifit$margins, by = 'site_id') %>%
  mutate(label = str_c(
    symbol, '\n',
    str_remove(site_id, '_._.:.') %>% str_replace('_', ':'), '\n',
    'p-value = ', signif(p_value, digits = 2))
  ) %>%
  mutate(label = as_factor(label)) %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, group_ord))

top_diffed_vaf <-
  edisites$counts %>%
  semi_join(top_diffed_marg, by = 'site_id', copy = TRUE) %>%
  collect() %>%
  filter(depth >= 10) %>%
  left_join(
    sample_metadata %>% select(sample_id, group),
    by = 'sample_id'
  ) %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, group_ord)) %>%
  left_join(
    select(top_diffed_marg, site_id, category) %>% distinct(),
    by = 'site_id', relationship = 'many-to-many'
  ) %>%
  select(site_id, category, group, sample_id, vaf) %>%
  inner_join(
    top_diffed_marg %>%
      select(site_id, label) %>%
      distinct(),
    by = 'site_id'
  )

marg_plot <- function(cat) {
  top_diffed_marg %>%
    filter(category == cat) %>%
    ggplot(aes(group, estimate)) +
    geom_jitter(
      aes(y = vaf, col = group),
      data = top_diffed_vaf %>% filter(category == cat),
      height = 0,
      alpha = 0.33,
      size = 0.75,
      width = 0.4,
      show.legend = F
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper),
      width = 0.7
    ) +
    coord_flip() +
    facet_wrap(~label, ncol = 3) +
    labs(
      x = 'Group',
      y = 'Editing VAF'
    )
}
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### ALU

if ('ALU' %in% top_diffed_marg$category) {
  marg_plot('ALU')
}
```

#### REP

  marg_plot('REP')
}
```

#### NONREP

  marg_plot('NONREP')
}
```

```

:::

### Top differentially edited sites, 1000 per VEP impact

Significant differentially edited sites (q < `r sig_q`), top 1000 by p-value within each VEP impact category, split into tabs.

```{r top_diff_table}
top_diff <-
  edifit$anova %>%
  filter(term == 'group') %>%
  left_join(
    edisites$summary %>%
      select(site_id, redi_acc, is_adar, rep_type, consequence, impact, symbol, biotype, amino_acids),
    by = 'site_id'
  ) %>%
  filter(q_value_bh < sig_q) %>%
  mutate(impact = factor(impact, c('HIGH', 'MODERATE', 'LOW', 'MODIFIER'))) %>%
  group_by(impact) %>%
  slice_min(order_by = p_value, n = 1000) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(impact, p_value) %>%
  select(site_id, redi_acc, p_value, q_value_bh, rep_type, symbol, impact, consequence, amino_acids)
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### HIGH
```{r top_diff_high}
top_diff %>% filter(impact == 'HIGH') %>% select(-impact) %>% esf_datatable()
```

#### MODERATE
```{r top_diff_moderate}
top_diff %>% filter(impact == 'MODERATE') %>% select(-impact) %>% esf_datatable()
```

#### LOW
```{r top_diff_low}
top_diff %>% filter(impact == 'LOW') %>% select(-impact) %>% esf_datatable()
```

#### MODIFIER
```{r top_diff_modifier}
top_diff %>% filter(impact == 'MODIFIER') %>% select(-impact) %>% esf_datatable()
```

:::

### PCA - Group and covariates

Principal components of editing rate at the top differential sites, coloured by group and by each covariate, to check what structure the editing captures.

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Plot
```{r pca}

pca_data <-
  edifit$anova %>% 
  filter(term == 'group') %>% 
  slice_min(order_by = p_value, n = 10000, with_ties = F) %>% 
  select(site_id) %>% 
  inner_join(
    edifit$margins %>% 
      add_count(site_id) %>% 
      filter(n ==  n_distinct(sample_metadata$group)) %>% 
      select(site_id, group, estimate),
    by = 'site_id'
  ) %>% 
  inner_join(
    sample_metadata %>% select(sample_id, group),
    by = 'group',
    relationship = 'many-to-many'
  ) %>% 
  left_join(
    edisites$counts %>% 
      select(site_id, sample_id, vaf) %>% 
      collect(),
    by = c('site_id', 'sample_id')
  ) %>% 
  mutate(vaf = if_else(is.na(vaf), estimate, vaf)) %>% 
  select(site_id, sample_id, vaf) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = site_id, values_from = vaf) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  column_to_rownames('sample_id')
  
ed_pca <- prcomp(pca_data)

ed_pca_covar <-
  sample_metadata %>% 
  select(sample_id, group, all_of(fixed_effects)) %>% 
  inner_join(
    edisites$sample_summary %>% 
      select(sample_id, med_vaf)
  ) %>% 
  inner_join(
    as.data.frame(ed_pca$x[,1:5]) %>% 
        rownames_to_column('sample_id'),
    by = 'sample_id'
  )

ps <-
  c('group', fixed_effects, 'med_vaf') %>% 
  map(
    function(x) {
      ed_pca_covar %>% 
        ggplot(aes(PC1, PC2)) +
        geom_point(
          aes(col = !!sym(x)),
          alpha = 0.5,
          size = 0.75) +
        coord_fixed()
    }
  )

wrap_plots(ps)
```

#### Table
```{r pca_table}
ed_pca_covar %>%
  esf_datatable()
```

:::

### Clustered heatmap at differential sites

Editing rate (model estimate) across groups for the top differential sites, clustered to reveal groups of sites and samples with similar editing patterns. The sidebar marks repetitive vs non-repetitive sites.

```{r pheatmap}
ann <-
  edisites$summary %>%
  filter(site_id %in% colnames(marg_rate)) %>%
  mutate(Status = if_else(rep_type == 'NONREP', 'Non-repetitive', 'Repetitive')) %>%
  select(site_id, Status) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  column_to_rownames('site_id')

pheatmap::pheatmap(
  marg_rate,
  clustering_method = 'average',
  show_colnames = F,
  annotation_col = ann,
  annotation_colors = list(Status = c(
    Repetitive = unname(rep_type_cols[['ALU']]),
    'Non-repetitive' = unname(rep_type_cols[['NONREP']])
  ))
)
```

    }
  }) %>% 
  enframe(name = 'Parameter', value = "Value") %>%
